# Overview (project note)

《金石萃編》, 160 卷, compiled by 王昶 (1725–1806), completed 嘉慶十年（1805）.
The largest integrated 目錄+存文+集釋+按語 collection of pre-Qing inscriptions.
Modelled on [[Hong Kuo 洪適《隸釋》]].
